title: Langfuse read-only pull
boundary: Observation names, status and trace references only; no input/output or full logs. Data stays quarantined. No customer replies, model calls or Agent execution. Cloud / self-hosted v4 observations v2 only.
credentials: Use company vault reference IDs, never key values. Pinned versions and a fixed time window; not a live connection.
confirmRestart: Replay this window for late arrivals. Dedup remains; snapshots are not overwritten. No automatic continuation.
updated: Status updated. You choose when to read another page.
cancelled: Cancelled. A completed page may have committed; refresh status before continuing.
error: Read failed. Check admin access, vault references, origin and window. Refresh before retrying.
unsupported: Observations v2 unavailable. Verify Cloud or v4 support; no legacy fallback.
rateLimited: Rate limited. Wait for the provider allowance, then explicitly retry the same page.
